results.question: Queued jobs repeatedly retry; what should we investigate?

retrieved.quote: Compare task arrival rate with worker completion rate and inspect retry counts. Identify whether a small group of poison messages repeatedly fails. Review the downstream dependency error rate before adding more workers and amplifying load.

results.question: Which checks confirm that cache recovery is working?

results.question: Which counts show database connection exhaustion?

retrieved.quote: Inspect active, idle and waiting connection counts in the application pool. Compare the pool limit with the database connection budget across all replicas. Look for transactions that hold a connection after their request has finished.
retrieved.title: Database connection pool exhaustion
retrieved.usage_note: Evidence type has not been reviewed; inspect the full source before acting.

metric_notes.quality_gate: Strict exact labeled evidence set and expected status for every case; unlabeled passages count as extra under these labels.
metric_notes.passed: Correct status and all labeled passages retrieved; extra irrelevant passages do not fail this outcome.
metric_notes.exact_evidence_set_passed: Correct outcome with no missing or extra passages.
metric_notes.precision_at_returned_5: Mean positive-case labeled hits divided by returned passages; empty returns score zero.
metric_notes.precision_fixed_at_5: Mean positive-case distinct labeled hits divided by five, including empty slots.
metric_notes.integrity: Structured reference authorization, current sources, applicability and exact quotes/hashes; not semantic entailment.
metric_notes.latency: Local HTTP request time, excluding build/startup and evaluator integrity reads; not a load benchmark.
